Hi Ava — thanks for the note and heads up on timing.

Quick summary of two clean options that map to your ask:

1) Staged Uplift (recommended)
- Baseline monthly commit: increase from 3M tokens -> 6M tokens
- Tiered rate bands: standard rate for first 6M, discounted band starting at 8M
- Burst pocket: 10% of monthly commit available per month (can be used across days)
- Soft throttle: kicks in at sustained 110% of commit; brief token-level buffering and gentle reject-after-threshold at sustained 140% for latency protection

2) Aggressive Commit + Minimal Burst
- Baseline commit: 9M tokens/month
- Burst pocket: additional 5% emergency buffer
- Soft throttle: deferred to 125% sustained; lower chance of rejects but higher monthly cost

I'll attach a draft amendment (SOW + pricing) and a simple forecast workbook that projects monthly consumption against the two options. If it helps, we can do a quick 30-minute call Thursday morning to walk Marcus through how throttles and burst pockets interact with KV and prefix caching.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/67890/deal/DEAL-4892

Next steps I suggest: you pick option, we put up draft amendment in DocuSign, operations (Kim) and finance (Ben) do a quick review.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
